name: Brian Gold
caption: The founder, owner, and top star of the Gold Wrestling Federation, wrestling under his own name as "Mister Sexy" Brian Gold while running the promotion he built.
notes: The federation's own founder and owner wrestled under his own name, billed as "Mister Sexy" Brian Gold, while also writing the promotion's flagship weekly show, Tuesday Night Terror, himself.

name: Guy Gilette
caption: A GWF staffer billed as the President's cousin, announcing the fed's Tuesday show and conducting interviews.
notes: Billed in the fed's own founding document as a straight-arrow staffer who rarely takes sides, announcing the Tuesday Night Terror show and conducting interviews.

name: Greg Tompson
caption: A GWF staffer promoted into an on-air announcing role after a car-accident encounter with the fed's Co-President.
notes: Billed in the fed's own founding document as a high-ranking staffer hired after the Co-President's car struck him, announcing both weekly shows and conducting interviews.

name: Victoria Gold
caption: A GWF announcer and interviewer billed as the founder's wife and former on-screen escort.
notes: Billed in the fed's own founding document as Brian Gold's wife and former escort persona "Queen Victoria," now announcing the Saturday Night Sparks show and conducting interviews.
